title: EchoFox config, ~/.echofox/config.json
description: Every key of the config, its type and its owner (x-owner: the component that defines its meaning and default; docs/design.md, "Settings"). The file holds only the user's choices; a missing key means the owner's default. Every object allows keys that are not listed: a reader leaves out a key it does not know, and a writer keeps it (docs/design.md, "The config file over versions"). The ranges of numbers are the owners' (server/tuning.py). server/test_contract.py and macos/Sources/echofox-tests check both sides against this file.

version.description: The format, 11. It changes only for a change that an older reader would get wrong.

model.description: The model chosen in the menu, a name in models.

language.description: The speech's language code; empty: the server's default.

models.description: The model registry by name; the first is the default.

llamaServer.description: The llama-server's URL; one on this Mac the server starts itself.

variant.description: A variant of the catalog entry (q4_0, q8_0).

adapters.description: The adapters by name: whether each is on, and its context budgets over its manifest's.

languages.description: By language code, or "*" for every language (notes only).

modelIdleSeconds.description: Without a recording for this long, the model leaves memory; 0 keeps it.
